options.text: The probability of $A$ given that $B$ has occurred
The probability of $B$ given that $A$ has occurred

questions.explanation: $P(A\,|\,B)$ reads 'the probability of $A$ given $B$'. It is the probability that event $A$ occurs, knowing that event $B$ has already occurred.

questions.stem: In a class, $P(\text{glasses}) = 0.4$ and $P(\text{glasses and left-handed}) = 0.1$. What is $P(\text{left-handed}\,|\,\text{glasses})$?
